c74object.name: el.splitspec~
c74object.digest: FFT-based spectral bin splitter for pfft~
c74object.description:
el.splitspec~ is a frequency-domain spectral splitter designed to operate inside a pfft~ subpatcher. It accepts magnitude and phase signal vectors from an FFT analysis and disperses the spectral bins across a specified number of multichannel output pairs (from 2 up to 64 channel pairs, must be a power of 2), where each pair outputs the magnitude and phase for that spectral segment. Bin distributions can be randomly scrambled (scramble), organized into interleaved spirals (spiral), grouped into contiguous frequency blocks (squantize), explicitly mapped (setstate), stored and recalled from presets (store, recall), and smoothly crossfaded over time (ramptime) or by hand (manual_override).
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / messages): Magnitude input signal vector, and control message inlet (scramble, spiral, squantize, store, recall, setstate, ramptime, bypass, manual_override).
Inlet 2 (signal): Phase input signal vector.
Inlet 3 (signal): Table offset factor. Shifts the spectral distribution table.
Inlet 4 (signal): Bin offset factor. Applies a rotational bin offset across the spectrum.
Inlet 5 [Rightmost Inlet] (signal): Manual interpolation control (0.0 to 1.0). Morphs between previous and current bin distributions when manual_override is active.
Outlets
Outlets 1 to 2N (signal): Interleaved Magnitude and Phase output vectors for each spectral segment (Segment 1 Mag, Segment 1 Phase, Segment 2 Mag, Segment 2 Phase, etc.).
Second to Rightmost Outlet (float): Ramp sync. Emits a float value from 0.0 to 1.0 tracking crossfade interpolation progress.
Rightmost Outlet (list): Current bin state list. Emits the active bin mapping list when queried with showstate.

inlet.description: Magnitude signal vector from an FFT analysis, as well as state, routing, and configuration messages.
Phase signal vector from an FFT analysis.
Shifts the channel assignment mapping across the distribution table.
Applies a rotational bin offset across the spectrum.
Crossfade position between previous and current spectral distributions when manual_override is active.

outlet.digest: (signal) Spectrum Segment 1 ... N (Mag and Phase pairs)
outlet.description: Interleaved magnitude and phase signal vectors for each spectral segment channel pair.
Normalized float value tracking interpolation progress between distribution states.
Emits the current bin mapping list when queried via showstate.

objarg.name: channel-pairs
objarg.description: The number of output channel pairs to create (default: 2, range: 2 to 64). Must be a power of 2. Each pair creates two signal outlets: Magnitude and Phase.

method.name: bypass
method.description: When set to 1, bypasses spectral splitting and routes all spectral energy equally to all output pairs. When set to 0 (default), normal spectral splitting is active.

method.name: manual_override
method.description: When set to 1, automatic timed interpolation is paused and crossfading between states is driven manually by the rightmost signal inlet. When set to 0 (default), interpolation uses ramptime.

method.name: overlap
method.description: Sets the analysis overlap factor for ramp time compensation (default: 8, range: 2 to 4096). Must be a power of 2.

method.name: ramptime
method.description: Sets the time in milliseconds to morph between spectral states (default: 1000.0 ms).

method.name: recall
method.description: Recalls a preset bin mapping stored in memory slot slot-index (0 to 127) and begins interpolation.

method.name: scramble
method.description: Permutes all spectral bins randomly among the output channel pairs and initiates crossfade interpolation.

method.name: setstate
method.description: Sets the exact destination channel mapping for all spectral bins. The list length must equal half of the pfft~ FFT size.

method.name: showstate
method.description: Dumps the current bin distribution mapping as a list out the rightmost outlet.

method.name: spiral
method.description: Distributes spectral bins in an interleaved spiral pattern across the output channel pairs and begins interpolation.

method.name: squantize
method.description: Groups the spectrum into contiguous frequency blocks of size block-size and assigns them sequentially across output pairs.

method.name: store
method.description: Saves the current bin distribution into memory slot slot-index (0 to 127).

method.name: signal
method.description: Signals arriving at inlets 1 and 2 are magnitude and phase vectors. Signals arriving at inlets 3 through 5 control table offsets, bin offsets, and manual crossfading at audio rate.
